reason: I fill my nights through PR people, WhatsApp lists and regulars, and 500 sign-ups in a city is nothing next to my lists. Free listing I might let you do, but I would not plan to pay for it.
objection: My competitors will be on it too, so what do I gain? Paying to be 'featured' next to the club down the road doesn't bring me one extra student.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real numbers from other venues here: a few thousand active users who are students, and tickets or entries actually coming through the app that I don't already get from my PR.
